description: List all data transformation (DTL) classes in the namespace. Returns non-abstract classes that extend Ens.DataTransformDTL or Ens.DataTransform, showing their fully-qualified class names. Use 'prefix' to narrow by dotted-package prefix (e.g. 'MyPackage.Transforms'). Use 'filter' for a case-insensitive substring match. Use 'cursor'/'nextCursor' for pagination (default page size: 100, max: 1000). Note: filtering is client-side — the full list is fetched from the server each page request.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor field

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter (client-side). Applied after prefix. Example: 'hl7' matches any transform whose name contains 'hl7', 'HL7', or 'Hl7'.

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to query a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

prefix.description: Dotted-prefix filter (client-side). Only transforms whose name starts with this prefix are returned. Example: 'MyPackage.Transforms' matches 'MyPackage.Transforms.ToHL7' but not 'OtherPackage.Transforms.ToHL7'.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_transform_list
title: List Data Transformations
